title: 印尼财长承诺3%护栏：项目却在预算外融资，财政纪律还守得住吗
speaker: Suwa Hasil Nizarra

segments.en: Right now, we are committed to the 3% fiscal role and maximum 60% of the debt to GDP ratio.
segments.zh: 目前，我们承诺遵守3%的财政护栏，以及债务占GDP比重最高60%的上限。

segments.en: That's signaling the confidence of the market that we can continue to do this.
segments.zh: 这向市场传递了信心信号，表明我们可以继续这样做。
